ref.quote: Programma voor uitgaven bestemd voor een sociaal energiebeleid ... Dotatie aan het sociaal stookoliefonds ... Toelagen in kader van de oproep tot projecten betreffende de energietransitie ... worden de monsternemingen, controles en analyses uitgevoerd door de Economische Inspectie.
ref.note: The largest items are not phrased because they are contracts, legal or international commitments: 'dotatie BE-WATT financiële verrichten' and provisions linked to the lifetime extension (LTO) of Doel 4 and Tihange 3, the 'Provisie energienorm', nuclear liabilities (NIRAS/ONDRAF for the IRE, SCK CEN) and the CERN contribution (pp. 889-890). Together these make up most of the line, so the phrases describe only its smaller, discretionary part. The Social Heating Oil Fund dotation was raised in 2026 'om de stijging van de energieprijzen op te vangen' (p. 130). confirmed: quotes found on pp. 130, 131, 134 and Tabel 1 pp. 888-892. The phrases cover only the discretionary part (heating oil fund, Economic Inspection, energy-transition calls); BE-WATT/nuclear lifetime extension, the energy-norm provision, NIRAS/ONDRAF liabilities and CERN are not phrased, so nothing suggests they move with the budget (flag 3). Owner should know the phrased items are a small share of this line.
